name: Picnic table
placement: On level lawn or patio, in the shade or with an umbrella through the centre hole; seats 6.
modeling: A top of boxes 1.83 x 0.72 m, 0.04 m thick at 0.71 m high, in the middle. Two bench planks 1.83 x 0.28 m at 0.43 m high along both long sides, each outside the top, joined to A-frame end legs from tilted 0.06 m boxes and one cross brace.
